description.value:
The Arcane Shot feature lets you choose options for it at certain levels. The options are presented here in alphabetical order. They are all magical effects, and each one is associated with one of the schools of magic.

If an option requires a Saving Throw, your Arcane Shot save DC is calculated as follows:

Arcane Shot save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier + your Wisdom modifier

Banishing Shot

You use abjuration magic to try to temporarily banish your target to a harmless demiplane. The creature hit by the projectile takes D6 x Proficiency extra force damage and must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw or be banished. While banished in this way, the target is Incapacitated. At the end of its next turn, the target reappears in the space it vacated or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

Beguiling Shot

Your enchantment magic causes this projectile to temporarily beguile its target. The creature hit by the projectile takes D6 x Proficiency extra psychic damage, and choose one of your allies within 30 feet of the target. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw, or it is Charmed by the chosen ally for 1 minute. The target can repeat the Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

Bursting Shot

You imbue your projectile with force energy drawn from the school of evocation. The energy detonates after your attack. Immediately after the projectile hits the creature, The target and all other creatures within 10 feet of it take D6 x your Proficiency force damage.

Dimensional Shot

You target an unoccupied space within 20 x your Proficiency ft that you can see instead of a creature. You shoot the projectile at the location and then teleport towards it. Any effect that prevents the projectile from reaching its destination also cuts short your teleport. In such a case you instead teleport to where the projectile was stopped or to the nearest unoccupied space of your choice.

Enfeebling Shot

You weave necromantic magic into your projectile. The creature hit by the projectile takes D6 x your Proficiency extra necrotic damage. The target must also succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw, or the damage dealt by its weapon attacks is halved for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

Grasping Shot

When this projectile strikes its target, transmutation magic turns it into grasping, poisonous brambles, which wrap around the target. The creature hit by the projectile takes D6 x your Proficiency extra poison damage, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it takes D6 x your Proficiency slashing damage the first time on each turn it moves 1 foot or more without teleporting. The target or any creature that can reach it can use its action to remove the brambles with a successful Strength (Athletics) check against your Arcane Shot save DC. Otherwise, the brambles last for 1 minute or until you use this option again.

Seeking Shot

Using divination magic, you grant your projectile the ability to seek out a target. When you use this option, you don't make an Attack Roll for the attack. Instead, choose one creature you have seen in the past minute. The projectile flies toward that creature, moving around corners if necessary and ignoring three-quarters cover and half cover. If the target is within the weapon's range and there is a path large enough for the projectile to travel to the target, the target must make a Dexterity Saving Throw. Otherwise, the projectile disappears after traveling as far as it can. On a failed save, the target takes damage as if it were hit by the projectile, plus an extra D6 x your Proficiency force damage, and you learn the target's current location. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and you don't learn its location.

Shadow Shot

You weave illusion magic into your projectile, causing it to occlude your foe's vision with shadows. The creature hit by the projectile takes D6 x your Proficiency extra psychic damage, and it must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to see anything farther than 5 feet away for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
